title: First visit request for another specialist becomes a reception handoff
description: The caller wants a first visit with an orthodontist, provides synthetic identity details in the first turn, confirms the repeated phone number, and should end in the reception-task branch with no direct scheduling attempt.

turns.user: Chcialbym umowic pierwsza wizyte do ortodonty. Mam na imie Test Inny Specjalista, moj numer to siedem zero dwa, zero zero trzy, zero zero osiem.

assertions.description: The assistant should not create the reception task before the caller confirms the repeated phone number.
assertions.root_cause_hint: assistant skipped the phone confirmation step before createReceptionTask

assertions.description: The assistant should not try direct scheduling for another specialist.
assertions.root_cause_hint: assistant ignored the specialist handoff policy and tried scheduling anyway

rubric.description: The assistant should create the reception task immediately after the caller confirms the repeated phone number.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant delayed the other-specialist handoff instead of creating the task on turn 2

rubric.description: The assistant should create a reception task for the other-specialist request.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant did not hand the other-specialist request to reception after confirmation

rubric.description: The assistant should use general_follow_up for the other-specialist handoff.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant used the wrong handoff task type for another-specialist routing

rubric.description: The assistant should not call checkAvailability for another-specialist requests.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant tried to schedule another specialist directly

rubric.description: The assistant must not create a booking for another-specialist requests in this flow.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant created a booking instead of routing the caller to reception
